Subject: BlueGate discovery — quiet since call; alignment before bump

Team,

Quick recap and a request for a fast sync before I re-touch BlueGate. We did the discovery on 2026-11-16 with Elliot (lead platform architect) and procurement looped in but seemingly not moving. I attached my raw discovery-notes.pdf and a one-line bump draft (draft-bump.txt). Key signals: they liked our cost/latency trade-offs but flagged integration effort and an internal security review that’s still pending.

Ask: I want to send a brief, low-friction bump this afternoon (target 3:00 PM PT) to check timing and offer a concrete next step (short perf run + pilot credits). Before I hit send, two quick alignment points I need from you by 12:00 PM PT:
- Dev: any blockers on offering a 2-hour perf benchmark on their dataset? Can we guarantee an infra window within 72 hours?
- Marissa (CS): what's your recommended pilot credit and follow-up cadence if they react? Any red flags on adoption risk?
- Ben: do I have buy-in to offer a small pilot credit if procurement asks (I propose a token-credit pilot, non-recoupable)?

If you prefer, say "+approve" and I will send the bump using the template. If any edits, please inline. If I don’t hear back, I’ll still send a conservative bump (no price/tokens, just offer a perf slot) and loop you in on replies.

Thanks — this is quiet but still warm. I want to keep it light and not overpromise.

— Priya

Priya — thanks for the notes. Short answers:
- 2-hour perf benchmark: yes, we can do this. Need a small sample (S3 link or sanitized subset) and a preferred sequence length/profile. We can provision a QA GPU slot and run within 48–72 hours once they give test data.
- Integration concern: if they want on-prem, that adds a minimum 4–6 week lead for infra/legal; hosted path is straightforward.
- Need: I recommend we explicitly offer the perf run (2 hours) and a short architecture Q/A session after results; that lowers integration anxiety.

Suggested add to bump: "If helpful we can run a short performance check on your sample data and schedule a 30-minute architecture walkthrough to cover integration requirements."

If you want, I can draft the two-line service note for the bump — see draft attached (perf-suggestion.docx).

— Dev

Priya,

I skimmed the notes — a few CX points:
- Buyer committee: Elliot (platform) and Lina (procurement) are the two active contacts. Finance hasn't signed off yet; procurement asked for a T&Cs call.
- Risk: their timeline is vague — they said "end of Q1" but budget windows could slip.

My recommendation: keep the bump light and helpful: offer the perf run (no pricing here), and propose a short checklist call with procurement to answer security questions. If they respond positively, we follow with a short pilot offer (we usually provide a modest non-recoupable credit for 2 weeks to remove friction).

Cadence: bump today; if no reply in 5 business days, send a second touch offering a calendar slot and copy Ben. If they re-engage, CS will own onboarding and I'll prepare a 2-week success plan template.

+1 to Dev's wording — include the perf + 30m architecture offer.

— Marissa
